blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – House Speaker Faustino “Bojie” Dy III on Thursday said congressional amendments to the P7.2-trillion proposed budget for next year should not be automatically presumed to involve corruption and wrongdoing as the chamber faces heightened scrutiny over its spending bill. “Not all changes made by Congress to the budget are wrong,” Dy said in a statement in Filipino. “It is the duty of lawmakers to advocate for the needs of their districts.” READ: Lawmakers also ‘denied’ transparency in 2027 budget bill “What matters is that the projects are proper, fully documented, and deliver genuine benefit to the people,” he […]...
